method: Least-squares axis through five paired bright ground markers in returned-extent CUZK Ortofoto; 350 m subset centered inside observed marker span
interpretation: Full published 350 x 20 m dimensions placed on the imagery-derived axis. Endpoints are derived, not surveyed physical thresholds; absolute accuracy remains unmeasured.
uncertaintyKind: Conservative engineering allowances, NOT measured absolute accuracy or survey precision

precisionAcceptance.reason: No independent surveyed threshold/edge control in acquired sources. Fit residuals, pixel resolution and engineering allowances do not measure absolute accuracy.

verticalAccuracyNote: DMR export sampling resolution is not survey accuracy
